name: Giving Life
overview: Scripture reveals that life originates from God, who formed man from the dust and breathed into him the breath of life, making him a living soul (Genesis 2:7). God intimately forms and sustains life even in the womb (Psalms 139:13), affirming His authority as the God of the living, not the dead (Luke 20:38). In Christ is life itself, described as the light of men (John 1:4), and He possesses the power to give life and quicken whom He wills (John 5:21). This life is spiritual, brought forth by the Spirit and expressed through the words of Jesus, which are both spirit and life (John 6:63).
